# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_hold_exploration.py". Change the tables there and re-run.
# Province scope.

DA_HX_select_pathfinders = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
}

DA_HX_select_wardens = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
}

DA_HX_select_prospectors = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
}

DA_HX_select_loreseekers = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
	set_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers
}

# called at the end of the roll (DA_Hold_exploration_workaround): the charter has done its work
DA_HX_end_roll = {
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
	clr_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
	owner = { if = { limit = { ai = no } DA_HX_refresh_ready_count = yes } }
}

# Country scope. How many holds could send a company now: the tooltip of the explore marker of the top bar.
# Also run on the monthly pulse for players (common/on_actions/DA_Attention_Markers_on_actions.txt).
DA_HX_refresh_ready_count = {
	set_variable = { which = DA_HX_ready_count value = 0 }
	every_owned_province = {
		limit = { DA_HX_can_send = yes }
		owner = { change_variable = { which = DA_HX_ready_count value = 1 } }
	}
}

# The Send button. The company leaves now; the floor table rolls when the modifier of its way down has run out.
DA_HX_send = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_2 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { add_treasury = -40 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_treasury = -25 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_send_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			DA_HX_end_roll = yes
			remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
			if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_prospectors }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_loreseekers }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			set_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
			owner = { DA_HX_refresh_ready_count = yes }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_HX_target_3 = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_HX_charter_wardens }
			owner = { add_treasury = -75 }
		}
		else = {
			owner = { add_treasury = -50 }
		}

			DA_HX_end_roll = yes

			if = {

# The country menu (DA_adk_hold_exploration_menu.1). The AI keeps the old pace; a player's company is the one chosen
# in the Dwarven Hall (DA_HX_hall_charter_<id>) and travels like any company of that charter. The floor is found the way
# DA_Hold_exploration_workaround finds it. The price is paid by the menu (DA_HX_hall_pay_<n>).
DA_HX_depart_from_menu = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { ai = no } }
		DA_HX_end_roll = yes
		remove_province_modifier = DA_HX_company_below
		if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_1_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 20 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_2_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 58 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 58 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 35 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_3_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_4 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 50 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 80 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 80 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 50 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_4_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_5 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 65 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 102 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 102 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 65 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_5_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_6 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 80 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 125 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 125 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 80 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_6_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 95 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 148 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 148 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 95 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_7_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_8 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 110 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 170 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 170 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_8_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_9 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 125 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 192 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 192 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 125 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_9_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 140 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 215 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 215 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 140 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_has_dig_level_10_or_higher = yes NOT = { has_province_flag = DA_looked_dig_adk_11 } }
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_wardens
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 155 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_prospectors
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 238 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { owner = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers } }
				set_province_flag = DA_HX_run_loreseekers
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 238 }
			}
			else = {
				add_province_modifier = { name = DA_HX_company_below duration = 155 }
			}
		}
	}
	set_province_flag = DA_expedition_in_progress
}

# Country scope. The plaques of the Dwarven Hall: the company the country menu sends.
DA_HX_hall_select_pathfinders = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers
}

DA_HX_hall_select_wardens = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers
	set_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens
}

DA_HX_hall_select_prospectors = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers
	set_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors
}

DA_HX_hall_select_loreseekers = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors
	clr_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers
	set_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers
}

# Country scope. What a departure of the country menu costs, deep by deep, and the line that says who goes (the AI
# never chooses a company: it pays the usual price, without the line).
DA_HX_hall_pay_2 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_wardens }
		add_treasury = -40
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_wardens
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_prospectors }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_prospectors
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_HX_hall_charter_loreseekers }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_loreseekers
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ai = no }
		add_treasury = -25
		custom_tooltip = DA_HX_hall_go_2_pathfinders
	}
	else = {
		add_treasury = -25
	}
}
